annotations.title: Live fast chargers on a road trip

description: Fast chargers (DC or 50 kW and more) within 2 km of one Roadcut road trip, with how many are free, in use or out of order now, power, card payment and, where published, the price without an app: in euros, or in the local currency in its own field for Poland (PLN), Denmark (DKK) and the UK (GBP); for Norway and Sweden the networks' published list price in NOK or SEK, not a live price. Refreshed about every 20 minutes from open operator data. Live status exists for Germany, the Netherlands, France, Finland, Poland, Slovenia, Luxembourg, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Belgium, Lithuania and Switzerland, and in the UK for IONITY and Blink Charging only. Swiss stations have status but no price; their source, "Bundesamt für Energie BFE / ich-tanke-strom.ch", is in `sources` and in each Swiss station's `source` field. Austrian chargers are not in this tool: their source does not allow passing the data on, so they are shown on roadcutco.com only. A trip is identified by its slug.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

only_free.description: Only stations with at least one free charger. Default false.
